Summary stats mean_val <- mean(x_vals_non_na) sd_val <- sd(x_vals_non_na) nepal_value <- df |> filter(`Country Name` == "Nepal") |> pull(.data[[v]]) |> first() # Detect whether values are effectively integers is_integerish <- length(x_vals_non_na) > 0 && all(abs(x_vals_non_na - round(x_vals_non_na)) < 1e-8) # Choose histogram settings automatically if (is_integerish && diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) <= 50) { hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } else { # Freedman-Diaconis rule for continuous variables iqr_val <- IQR(x_vals_non_na) n_val <- length(x_vals_non_na) fd_binwidth <- 2 * iqr_val / (n_val^(1 / 3)) fd_binwidth <- 0.5 * fd_binwidth # Fallback if IQR is zero or binwidth is not usable if (!is.finite(fd_binwidth) || fd_binwidth <= 0) { rng <- diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) fd_binwidth <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng / 30 else 1 } hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = fd_binwidth, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } caption_text <- paste0( "Mean = ", scales::number(mean_val, accuracy = 0.01), " | SD = ", scales::number(sd_val, accuracy = 0.01) ) p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]])) + hist_geom + annotate( "rect", xmin = mean_val - sd_val, xmax = mean_val + sd_val, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.12 ) + geom_vline( xintercept = mean_val, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.48 ) + # geom_vline( # xintercept = c(mean_val - sd_val, mean_val + sd_val), # color = "blue", # linetype = "dashed", # linewidth = 0.8 # ) + labs( title = paste("Histogram of", x_lab), x = x_lab, y = "Count", caption = caption_text ) + theme_minimal() + theme( plot.caption = element_text( hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 8) ), plot.caption.position = "plot" ) if (!is.na(nepal_value)) { p <- p + geom_vline( xintercept = nepal_value, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8 ) } p } ) walk(plots, print) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ranju_files/figure-html/variable_plots-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ranju_files/figure-html/variable_plots-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ranju_files/figure-html/variable_plots-3.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ranju_files/figure-html/variable_plots-4.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ranju_files/figure-html/variable_plots-5.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Formal Model $$ \begin{align} PSB_i &\sim \text{Normal}(\mu_i,\sigma) \\ \mu_i &= \alpha + \beta_{COR} COR_i + \beta_{VNA} VNA_i + \beta_{GEF} GEF_i + \beta_{ROL} ROL_i \\ \alpha &\sim \text{Normal}(0,1) \\ \beta_{COR} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,1) \\ \beta_{VNA} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,1) \\ \beta_{GEF} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,1) \\ \beta_{ROL} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,1) \\ \sigma &\sim \text{Normal}(0,20), \quad \sigma > 0 \end{align} $$ | Variable | Description | Unit | |----------|-------------|------| | $PSB_i$ | Political stability | percentile | | $COR_i$ | Perception of Corruption | standardized | | $VNA_i$ | Voice and Accountability | standardized | | $GEF_i$ | Government Effectiveness (percentile) | standardized | | $ROL_i$ | Rule of Law | standardized | #
